title: Improved Training of Strong Stochastic Flow Maps
abstract: arXiv:2610.29605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stochastic flow maps promise few-step sampling of stochastic differential equations (SDEs) by learning to directly jump between times along the solution path, yet training these models to learn this solution map remains difficult. The primary obstacle is the Brownian path itself: it is an infinite-dimensional object which needs to be passed to the neural network and is nowhere differentiable, which makes the implementation of derivative-based losses that power the state-of-the-art deterministic flow maps just out of reach. We identify two core design principles which address these issues: a) represent the Brownian path with a basis which carries higher-order local information, and b) train with an objective that forces the network to use the full representation of the path, not just the first order. To address this, we leverage the shifted Legendre polynomial expansion with a Wong-Zakai styled objective, unlocking derivative-based losses

translated_title: 强随机流映射的改进训练
translated_abstract: 随机流映射通过学习沿解路径直接在时间点之间跳跃，有望实现随机微分方程（SDE）的少步采样，然而训练这些模型来学习这一解映射仍然困难。主要障碍在于布朗路径本身：它是一个需要传递给神经网络的无穷维对象，且处处不可微，这使得为最先进的确定性流映射提供动力的基于导数的损失函数难以实现。我们确定了两个解决这些问题的核心设计原则：a) 使用携带高阶局部信息的基来表示布朗路径，b) 使用一个迫使网络利用路径完整表示（而不仅仅是一阶信息）的目标函数进行训练。为此，我们采用移位勒让德多项式展开并结合 Wong-Zakai 风格的目标函数，从而解锁了基于导数的损失函数。
tldr: 本文通过使用移位勒让德多项式展开来表示布朗路径，并结合 Wong-Zakai 风格的目标函数，改进了强随机流映射的训练，实现了基于导数的损失函数。
en_tdlr: This paper improves the training of strong stochastic flow maps by representing the Brownian path with a shifted Legendre polynomial expansion and a Wong-Zakai styled objective, thereby unlocking derivative-based losses.
